title: Palmer’s Chain of Command – Safeguarding Failures

entries.summary: First WhatsApp voice calls between Ben and Veritas (Emma) begin. Initial contact attempts logged.
Ben urgently requests confirmation that Alanna remains on bail. Veritas agrees to contact police.
Emma (Veritas) informs Ben that a police supervisor has been assigned to the case. She has no bail update.
Ben shares suicide risk escalation via WhatsApp. Police still not in contact. Quotes: 'This isn't sustainable', 'They almost got me again'.
